turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
Hello, I can help with a delivery address change. First I need to verify your order. Please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you, Cressida. I've checked order SC-5209. Unfortunately I can't change its delivery address to Lindenweg 9, Graz. Our policy allows an address change only until the order ships, and this order has already shipped and been delivered. Rule in English: "The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change." If you have a concern about the delivery itself, such as the print not arriving or being damaged, please tell me and I can help with that.
